headline: Get Hypnyto
title: How to Get Hypnyto | Bewitching Eye Soul | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Hypnyto is the special branch of Hypnowl. Hypnowl evolves at level fifty seven, and the normal result is Mesmerowl. To get Hypnyto instead, you must own the Bewitching Eye Soul item before you evolve. Guides also list a Gust Stone as part of the cost. Check the evolution screen to confirm each requirement. Pick your branch before you spend anything. Mesmerowl or Hypnyto, which one? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Hypnyto evolves from Hypnowl at level 57 if you own the Bewitching Eye Soul; without it Hypnowl becomes Mesmerowl.
joke: This owl evolution asks for a soul, and it still will not tell you the price.
